entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Don Diego Carrillo de Mendoza y Pimentel, 1st Marquess of Gélves was a Spanish cavalry general, viceroy of Aragon, and viceroy of New Spain. He held the latter position from September 21, 1621 to January 15, 1624 or November 1, 1624.
